# Android fixtures

These fixtures define the parser boundary for Android declarations in [epic #50](https://github.com/arminazimi/evergreen/issues/50), and the declarations the `android` detector matches to reviewed rules. The scope is the `android` block's `compileSdk`, `minSdk`, and `targetSdk` in `build.gradle` and `build.gradle.kts`; the Android Gradle Plugin and Kotlin plugin versions in `settings.gradle(.kts)`; the version catalog in `libs.versions.toml`; and string-notation Maven dependencies in the build scripts. Line numbers below are 1-based. `compileSdk`, `minSdk`, plugin, and catalog versions are parser examples without a matching reviewed rule. `targetSdk 34` matches `android.target-sdk.existing.default-below-35`. The positive build scripts also declare Google Play Billing Library `5.2.1`, which matches `android.play-billing.version-5`. The zero build scripts declare `targetSdk 35` and billing `10.0.0`, which are outside the bundled rules.

| Fixture file | Expected case |
| --- | --- |
| `positive/build.gradle` | `compileSdk 34` (line 7), `minSdk 21` (line 11), and `targetSdk 34` (line 12) inside `android` and `defaultConfig`. `targetSdk 34` matches `android.target-sdk.existing.default-below-35`. `namespace` (line 6), `versionCode` (line 13), and `versionName` (line 14) are not SDK declarations. `implementation 'com.android.billingclient:billing:5.2.1'` (line 19) is a string-notation Maven dependency that matches Play Billing major 5. |
| `positive/build.gradle.kts` | `compileSdk = 34` (line 7), `minSdk = 21` (line 11), and `targetSdk = 34` (line 12). `targetSdk = 34` matches the same target API rule. `namespace` (line 6) is not an SDK declaration. `implementation("com.android.billingclient:billing:5.2.1")` (line 19) is the Kotlin string-notation form of the same Play Billing dependency. |
| `positive/settings.gradle.kts` | The Android Gradle Plugin `com.android.application` version `8.5.2` (line 10) and the Kotlin Android plugin version `1.9.24` (line 11). `rootProject.name` (line 14) is not a declaration. |
| `positive/libs.versions.toml` | The `[versions]` entries `agp = "8.5.2"` (line 2) and `kotlin = "1.9.24"` (line 3). `androidx-core` (line 4) is a library version used through `version.ref` (line 7), and the plugin `android-application` (line 10) resolves its version from `agp`. |
| `negative/build.gradle` | A commented-out `compileSdk` (line 1) and `minSdk` (line 2), an unrelated `ext.buildTools` value (line 3), a `compileSdk` read from a variable (line 7), a `minSdk` read from a version catalog reference (line 10), a `targetSdk` interpolated from a variable (line 11), a string that mentions `compileSdk` (line 12), and a commented-out Play Billing dependency (line 17) produce no declarations. |
| `negative/build.gradle.kts` | A commented-out `compileSdk` (line 1) and `minSdk` (line 2), a `compileSdk` read from a variable (line 7), a `minSdk` read from a version catalog reference (line 10), a `targetSdk` read from a project property (line 11), a string that mentions `targetSdk` (line 12), and a commented-out Play Billing dependency (line 16) produce no declarations. |
| `negative/settings.gradle` | A commented-out plugin version (line 1), a commented-out Kotlin version (line 2), and unrelated `rootProject.name` and `include` keys (lines 3–4) produce no declarations. The plugin `com.android.application` at line 7 uses a variable version (`agpVersion`), so it has no literal version. |
| `negative/libs.versions.toml` | A commented-out `agp` (line 1), a note that mentions `agp` (line 3), a library whose `version.ref` points to a key that is not defined (line 6), and a plugin whose version is a template placeholder (line 9) produce no declarations. |
| `zero/build.gradle` | `compileSdk 35` (line 7), `minSdk 24` (line 11), and `targetSdk 35` (line 12), plus `implementation 'com.android.billingclient:billing:10.0.0'` (line 19): valid declarations, no lifecycle finding. `targetSdk 35` is outside `vers:intdot/<35`; billing 10 is outside the bundled majors. |
| `zero/build.gradle.kts` | `compileSdk = 35` (line 7), `minSdk = 24` (line 11), and `targetSdk = 35` (line 12), plus `implementation("com.android.billingclient:billing:10.0.0")` (line 19): valid declarations, no lifecycle finding. |
| `zero/settings.gradle.kts` | The plugin versions `8.7.0` (line 10) and `2.0.21` (line 11): valid declarations, no lifecycle finding. |
| `zero/libs.versions.toml` | The `[versions]` entries `agp = "8.7.0"` (line 2) and `kotlin = "2.0.21"` (line 3): valid declarations, no lifecycle finding. |
| `malformed/build.gradle.kts` | An unterminated string on `minSdk` (line 4) makes the file invalid Kotlin: no partial declarations, no error. |
| `malformed/libs.versions.toml` | An unterminated string on `agp` (line 2) makes the file invalid TOML: no partial declarations, no error. |

The zero fixtures are valid projects whose declarations match no reviewed rule, so they yield no lifecycle findings. Unclassified or lookalike values in the negative fixtures are not findings. Malformed fixtures are handled without an error or partial declarations.
